description: Everything WhatsApp shows about the account on a phone number: the contact (`pushname`, the name the person set; `isBusiness`, `verifiedName` and, for business accounts, `businessProfile` with description, categories, website, email, address, opening hours and linked Facebook/Instagram), the about text, the profile picture URL, the account's LID and the number of devices it uses (phone plus WhatsApp Web/desktop). `about` and `profile_picture_url` are `null` when the person hides or never set them; picture URLs expire after a while. A part that could not be read is `null` and named in `unavailable`. A number with no WhatsApp account answers 404 `not_registered`. Group: Numbers. Billing per call: 3 Credits.

phone.description: The phone number in international format with its country code, e.g. `+14155550123`. Spaces, dashes, brackets, a leading `00` or the WhatsApp id form (`14155550123@c.us`) are accepted.
